play.description: Starts the film playing for everyone in the room, from wherever it is.

pause.description: Pauses the film for everyone in the room, where it is.

seek_relative.description: Moves the film forward or back by an amount from where it is now. Use for rewind, go back, skip ahead.

params.name: seconds
params.description: How far to move, in seconds. Negative goes back.

seek.description: Moves the film to a position counted from its start.

params.name: position
params.description: The position as h:mm:ss, m:ss, or seconds.

load_title.description: Puts a film from the library on in this room, from its start, and posts the way in. Use when somebody asks to watch or switch to a film.

params.name: title
params.description: The film's id from the library, or its name.

room_state.description: Reads this room again: which film, where it is, whether it is playing, and who last changed it.

list_rooms.description: Lists every room watching a film, with where each has got to and how many are in it.

search_library.description: Finds films in the library by name. Use when a film is not in the list you were given.

get_title.description: Describes one film in the library: its length, cast, audio tracks, subtitles, and how long it stays on disk.

params.name: title
params.description: The film's id from the library, or its name.

search_catalogue.description: Identifies a film in the IMDb catalogue, giving its imdb id, year and cast, and whether the library already has it.

params.name: year
params.description: The year it came out, when somebody said it.

search_tracker.description: Finds releases of a film that can be downloaded, best first, each with a torrent id.

params.name: query
params.description: The film's name, with its year when known.

params.name: imdb_id
params.description: The film's imdb id from search_catalogue. Preferred over query when known.

download_status.description: Lists downloads in progress and finished ones still seeding, with how far each has got.

wish_list.description: Lists the films people are waiting to be able to download.

download_film.description: Proposes downloading a release. It starts only when somebody confirms, and the film then plays in this room as soon as it can be watched.

params.name: torrent_id
params.description: The torrent id of a release search_tracker returned.

fetch_subtitle.description: Proposes fetching English subtitles for a film in the library, which spends one of the day's subtitle downloads when confirmed.

params.name: title
params.description: The film's id from the library, or its name.

add_wish.description: Proposes waiting for a film the tracker does not have yet, and telling the person who asked when it can be downloaded.

params.name: imdb_id
params.description: The film's imdb id from search_catalogue.

keep_film.description: Proposes keeping a downloaded film on disk, so it is never pruned.

params.name: title
params.description: The film's id from the library, or its name.

let_go.description: Proposes removing a keep, so a downloaded film goes back on the clock and is pruned after its seeding time.

params.name: title
params.description: The film's id from the library, or its name.
